say:1:1330119001:0.text: Oh, no one comes here except the dead.
say:1:1330119001:0.source_cn: 噢，除了死人，平时没人在这里。
say:1:1330119001:0.male: Oh, no one comes here except the dead.
say:1:1330119001:0.female: Oh, no one comes here except the dead.

say:2:1330119002:0.text: But sometimes there are exceptions, like me, you guys, and the undead.
say:2:1330119002:0.source_cn: 但偶尔会有例外。比如我、比如你们，比如活死人。
say:2:1330119002:0.male: But sometimes there are exceptions, like me, you guys, and the undead.
say:2:1330119002:0.female: But sometimes there are exceptions, like me, you guys, and the undead.

say:4:1330119003:0.text: You heard it right. I come here every day to keep out the undead.
say:4:1330119003:0.source_cn: 是的，我之所以每天来这里巡视，就为了防止“活死人”出现。
say:4:1330119003:0.male: You heard it right. I come here every day to keep out the undead.
say:4:1330119003:0.female: You heard it right. I come here every day to keep out the undead.

say:5:1330119004:0.text: Once I spot them, I'll report it to the St. Callahan's Temple right away.
say:5:1330119004:0.source_cn: 一旦看到活死人，我会立即向镇子里圣杨凯维奇教堂的修士传...

say:5:1330119004:0.female: Once I spot them, I'll report it to the St. Callahan's Temple right away.

say:6:1330119005:0.text: It isn't a common occurrence, though. I've only encountered them a dozen times or so over the past few decades...
say:6:1330119005:0.source_cn: 不过这种情况不多，我巡视了几十年，也就碰到过十几次吧……
